name: Entangle
summary: Plants fill a 20-foot square with Difficult Terrain; creatures there fail a Strength save or are Restrained.
text: Grasping plants sprout across a 20-foot square of ground within range and turn it into Difficult Terrain until the spell ends, then vanish. Each creature other than you in the area when you cast the spell makes a Strength saving throw; on a failure it has the Restrained condition until the spell ends. A Restrained creature can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC, freeing itself from the plants on a success. Concentration, up to 1 minute.
